com.runesmith.request.books: Enchanted books the Runesmith can use
com.runesmith.building.runesmith.desc: Where the colony's enchanted books meet its gear. The Runesmith applies the Enchanter's books to armor, weapons and tools by the anvil's rules and without the XP: what you bring to the racks first, then what the colonists wear and hold, and if you allow it, gear from the warehouse. Build it as a Forge Hall, a Rune Tower or a Crystal Heart: the Runesmith structure pack has all three.
runesmith:runesmith.job.desc: Takes enchanted books from the colony's stock and applies them to armor, weapons and tools, following the vanilla anvil rules: in the hut's racks, on the colonists (guards first) and, if allowed, borrowed from the warehouse. A book is only spent when the piece really changes.
runesmith:runesmith.skills.desc: Knowledge and Mana grow with the work. A higher building lets the Runesmith use stronger books.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: Swords, axes, maces, bows, crossbows and tridents.
Pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, shears and fishing rods.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.runesmi: Book level limited by building level:
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: A level N Runesmith only uses books whose enchantments are at most level N. Stronger books stay in the colony's stock until the building grows.
Gear that already carries any enchantment is left alone.
Each book also costs lapis lazuli, one per level of the book: a level I book one, a level V book five.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.runesmi: Send finished gear to the warehouse:
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: Gear the Runesmith has enchanted in his racks, and that no book in stock has improved for two minutes, is carried to the warehouse by a courier, where the colonists can ask for it. Turn this off to keep finished gear in the racks for yourself.
The Runesmith also takes gear from the colony's warehouses, one piece at a time, enchants it at the anvil and puts it back where it was. Off by default: the warehouse holds what you may be keeping.

The Runesmith also walks to colonists, guards first, and enchants the armor they wear and the tool or weapon they hold. A worker's tool is left alone when the enchantment would make it too good for his hut.
